finding_key: docs/design/docs/docs-font-controls.md::new cross-cutting storage invariant is recorded only in docs/tasks/*, not in any design doc
evidence: Verified against the diff: only docs/tasks/active/20260819-* files were added, no docs/design/** file touched, yet packages/docs/src/model/document.ts (styleOffAsClear + BOOLEAN_INLINE_STYLE_KEYS) and packages/docs/src/store/block-helpers.ts (mergeInlineStyle) establish a new cross-cutting storage invariant consumed by all toggle callers and by YorkieDocStore.removedInlineStyleAttrs. The cited design docs exist and are silent on it — docs-font-controls.md §"Clear formatting" documents undefined-means-remove only for CLEAR_INLINE_STYLE, and docs-named-styles.md's cascade section ("writes keep storing raw runs") is now incomplete without the conditional-false exception. The one overstatement is that CONTRIBUTING.md's bug-fix path does not strictly mandate a design doc, but the repo convention (task docs get archived; design docs are canonical, "update the existing doc when evolving an area") makes the identified gap genuine. Documentation-only impact, so minor.
